baseline.name: Two-state stock dynamic programming
baseline.approach: Track best cash and held-stock values for each day under unlimited fee-free transactions.

why: Without fees, cooldowns or transaction limits, all positive adjacent changes telescope to the profit of rising runs.
quantitative_comparison: Both visit every price once and use constant state. The archive uses a positive-difference accumulation instead of two DP states, but no measured constant-factor advantage is established.
tradeoffs: The simpler greedy form cannot be transferred unchanged to fees/cooldowns/limited transactions. It reads prices[0], requiring nonempty input.
evidence_basis: Static greedy equivalence versus an equally linear rolling-state DP baseline; no timing comparison.
